verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API and official clients calculate the sales tax to collect for an order, with product-level tax codes per line item and an address validation endpoint. That covers the core of real-time API calculation. However, nothing in the evidence shows rooftop/address-level accuracy rather than ZIP-based rates, or latency suitable for checkout. Missing for 10: evidence of rooftop-level jurisdiction accuracy, documented latency/performance for in-checkout use, independent hands-on corroboration.
